meta.title: Newsletter — Agentware Studio
meta.description: Subscribe to the Agentware Studio monthly newsletter: one email a month with the month’s writing on Agentware and AI agent engineering, new courses and episodes, and the studio’s tool experiments. Unsubscribe any time.

page.title: Newsletter
page.lead: One email a month, with what’s worth reading from the past month gathered in one place. No email for every single blog post.
points: The month’s writing on Agentware and AI agent engineering
New courses and episodes as they launch
The studio’s tool experiments and open assets
page.cadence: Once a month · One-click unsubscribe in every email
page.privacy: Your email is used only to send this newsletter. It is delivered through the email service Resend and is never used for anything else or shared with third parties.
page.sentBody: We sent a confirmation email to {email}. Your subscription starts once you click the button in it. If it hasn’t arrived, check your spam folder.
page.errInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
page.errVerify: The human check didn’t pass. Please try again.
page.errServer: We couldn’t submit this right now. Please try again later.

confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
confirm.lead: Click the button below to finish subscribing.
confirm.doneBody: Welcome! Future newsletters will arrive in your inbox, and we’ve sent you a welcome email.
confirm.expired: This confirmation link has expired. Please go back to the newsletter page and submit your email again.
confirm.invalid: This confirmation link is not valid. Please go back to the newsletter page and submit your email again.
confirm.error: We couldn’t confirm this right now. Please try again later.

mail.confirmBody: Someone (hopefully you) subscribed this address to the Agentware Studio newsletter. Click the button below to confirm. The link is valid for 7 days.
mail.confirmIgnore: If this wasn’t you, simply ignore this email—you won’t hear from us again.
mail.welcomeBody: Thanks for subscribing. Once a month we’ll send a roundup of the month’s writing, new courses and episodes, and the studio’s latest experiments. Every email has an unsubscribe link at the bottom.
mail.footer: Agentware Studio · Independent Research & Creation Studio
mail.why: You’re receiving this because you subscribed to the Agentware Studio newsletter.
